answer: Operator Liability Escrow. Each wallet maps to a registered operator who posts a rolling escrow. When a cluster of wallets shares behavioral fingerprints (timing, gas patterns), the protocol debits the operator's escrow per flagged wallet, not the wallets. An attacker spinning up N sybils pays N debits against one escrow, and the ember of suspicion transfers to every future wallet that operator registers. Repeated flags trigger a canyon of escalating escrow requirements before new registrations clear. Honest operators recover funds on a mesa of clean epochs.
